input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, User roles. It manages core business objects including user, error info, black list. The platform provides capabilities for user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include task management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage error info records, so that I can track and organize error info data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage black list records, so that I can track and organize black list data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to interact with u r l functionality, so that I can accomplish my u r l-related tasks.
